claim.summary: For every odd p, the proper degree2 Boolean PC closure of x^2-x,y^2-y,(x+y)^2 has no nonzero affine relation. Thus U=span(x+y) survives the unit-error action, but every old-annihilating bilinear moment form on U vanishes: the binary degree2K reserve cannot replace pK uniformly. Over a finite perfect characteristic-p field, the diagonal of a p-linear moment tensor is a pth power of one linear form, so when its flattening rank exceeds1, diagonal zero is strictly weaker than radical membership. On the normalized binary one-bit domain span(1,x), all F2 moment pairings are singular while F4 admits a nonsingular one; extension size bounds are not minimal.
